title: Robot eating a snack
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- robot head -->
  <rect x="25" y="20" width="50" height="40" rx="10" fill="#4A6FA5"/>
  <!-- screen face -->
  <rect x="30" y="25" width="40" height="30" rx="6" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <!-- glowing eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="5" fill="#00E5FF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="5" fill="#00E5FF"/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="36.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="36.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- mouth - open, eating -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="49" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#00E5FF"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="49" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1="50" y1="20" x2="50" y2="10" stroke="#7FB3D5" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="8" r="3" fill="#FF6B9D"/>
  <!-- robot body -->
  <rect x="30" y="62" width="40" height="25" rx="6" fill="#5B8DB8"/>
  <!-- chest light -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="5" fill="#FF6B9D"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="2.5" fill="#FFB3D1"/>
  <!-- left arm reaching up with cookie -->
  <rect x="18" y="55" width="10" height="6" rx="3" fill="#7FB3D5"/>
  <rect x="10" y="48" width="14" height="10" rx="4" fill="#4A6FA5"/>
  <!-- cookie -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="52" r="7" fill="#D4A054"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="52" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#B8862E" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- cookie chips -->
  <circle cx="49" cy="49" r="1.2" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <circle cx="51" cy="55" r="1.2" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="54" r="1" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <rect x="72" y="55" width="10" height="6" rx="3" fill="#7FB3D5"/>
  <rect x="78" y="48" width="14" height="10" rx="4" fill="#4A6FA5"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="36" y="87" width="10" height="10" rx="3" fill="#4A6FA5"/>
  <rect x="54" y="87" width="10" height="10" rx="3" fill="#4A6FA5"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x="33" y="94" width="16" height="5" rx="2" fill="#7FB3D5"/>
  <rect x="51" y="94" width="16" height="5" rx="2" fill="#7FB3D5"/>
  <!-- ear bolts -->
  <rect x="21" y="32" width="5" height="10" rx="2" fill="#7FB3D5"/>
  <rect x="74" y="32" width="5" height="10" rx="2" fill="#7FB3D5"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="46" r="3" fill="#FF9CB8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="46" r="3" fill="#FF9CB8" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
